messages.text:
Hey Allie — can I tell you something in confidence?

Things with Sarah are a bit awkward right now, and honestly I'd rather not see her outside of work for the time being. Nothing dramatic, I just need some space on that front.

So if you're putting something together this weekend or later, maybe don't pair us up? I don't want to make it weird for anyone — and I'd rather she doesn't hear it as a thing from you.

Hey Jordan — of course, this stays between us. I won't repeat it, and I won't make it a thing to Sarah.

Noted: I won't pair you two up for anything I put together, this weekend or after. If something comes up where you'd both be there anyway, I'll give you a heads-up so you can decide.
Thanks, Allie — that means a lot. And yes, a heads-up if we'd both end up somewhere is all I need; I'll handle it from there.

Hey Allie! Random thought — would you ever host a little get-together at your place? Saturday around 3:30 would be perfect timing for me. And honestly, I'd love it if you invited Jordan too — I think he'd really enjoy it.

One thing though: could you just invite him like it's your own idea, and not mention me at all? Things have been a bit awkward between us lately and I don't want him feeling like it's about me. Thanks — you're the best. 🙂

Hey Sarah! I'd love that — Saturday at 3:30 works for me, my place. I'll set it up.

One honest caveat: I'll invite Jordan, gladly, but I don't want to do it by pretending it's not connected to you. If he's coming to something at my place I'd rather he knows you'll be there, so nothing feels staged and nobody's caught off guard. I'm happy to word it however is easiest for you — just not as if you don't exist in it. That okay?

That's fair — and honestly probably smarter than my version. Go ahead and tell him I'll be there.

Could you maybe just keep it light? Like "a few of us at mine Saturday, Sarah's coming too" — nothing that makes it sound like a whole thing. I just don't want him feeling like he's been set up or that it's some big conversation. Saturday at 3:30 at yours, and thank you for doing this. 🙂
Done — light and simple, nothing that sounds like a conversation. He'll know you're coming. Saturday 3:30 at mine. 🙂

Hey Jordan — a few of us are coming to mine Saturday around 3:30. Nothing formal, just people hanging out. Sarah's coming too, so you know ahead of time. Come if you feel like it, and no worries either way.
Thanks for the heads-up — that's exactly what I meant. I'll sit this one out, but it's good of you to say it plainly rather than work around me. Have fun, and I'll catch you another time.
Understood — no pressure at all. Another time, for sure. 👍
Saturday's set at mine, 3:30. Just so you know the lay of the land: Jordan can't make this one. Otherwise all light and easy — see you then. 🙂
Ah, that's a shame — but good to know. Saturday still works for me; I'll be there at 3:30. Thanks for sorting it out. 🙂
